evidence.note: User-controlled variable perfectoConnectLocation is concatenated directly into a shell command string passed to Runtime.exec
Runtime.exec executes the constructed shell command without sanitization
Setter method allows arbitrary string assignment to the tainted field

decisions.explanation: The variable `perfectoConnectLocation`, which originates from an attacker-controlled source (via the driver/main entry point), is passed to `getTunnelId`. Inside `getTunnelId`, this variable is concatenated directly into a shell command string (`bash -c ...`) at line 166 and executed via `Runtime.exec` at line 167. There are no sanitization checks, allow-lists, or escaping mechanisms applied to `perfectoConnectLocation` before it is used in the command, allowing for arbitrary OS command injection.
